notes.title: New Map : Island F! Decision to go free to play during Early Access.
notes.content:
New[b][/b][u][/u]
- Added a new optimized map called Island F. This will be the new default and worked-upon map. Over the past 6 months, I have been working on a few different maps and learning along the way. I feel that my experience will now allow me to create a map that will be fun to play on, look good and run well on most hardware. Unless feedback is received on this, I will be removing every other map in the near future. This will allow me to focus all of my attention on one map and make it the best that it can be. At the moment, the map for Island F has been removed but it will be added very soon.

[u][b]BIG NEWS - Free to Play for Now[/b][/u]
-Desperation was always intended to be a hardcore survival PVPVE game with hints of an RPG. Over the past 10 months, it's been apparent that most players of Desperation were playing solo. This has made it very difficult to gather the proper data I require to tweak and fix the PVP aspects of the game.
I understand that $20 or even $5 for an early access game is asking a lot for most people. I want to provide the best game that I possibly can and with the current numbers of players and the lack of PVP data/feedback, it's just impossible. Therefore, I will be starting the transition to free to play for the duration of Desperation's Early Access stage.

[u][b]Special Thanks[/b][/u]
- I want to thank everyone who has bought Desperation and supported me thus far.
Without you, I wouldn't have been able to continue working on Desperation and my dream of creating a game that I can be proud of and share would have faded. Your support has impacted me and helped me more than you know. For anyone who was willing to try my game but refunded it, I want to thank you as well and apologize. I'm sorry Desperation did not meet your expectations and I fully understand your decision. That drives me even further to continue and work on Desperation to increase its quality and fun factor. I hope to meet everyone's expectations in the near future and will be working hard to.
I hope everyone understands my decision and will continue to support me. Thank you again.

[u][b]Fixes/Changes[/b][/u]
- There were a few audio glitches that would occur during most melee animations. The audio was initially added for extra feedback but has been removed for now to offer a better experience and will hopefully be re-added later on.
- The amount of particles on screen during rainy/snowy weather conditions has been greatly reduced to help with the impact of performance. Know that this is hardly noticeable and the player will definitely still see plenty of snow/rain particles on screen.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.15 - New Map/Swimming/Dynamic Footstep Audio & More!
notes.content:
[u][b]New : [/b][/u]
- The all-new small-sized map Great Lake has been added! This map is still a work in progress but offers many looks into all of the new mechanics! The map Ui is not up to date with this map, but will be updated asap.
- Swimming is now in Desperation! Try out the all-new map [b]Great Lake[/b] to test out the new swimming mechanic that will be introduced to all maps! 
- Lootable houses are slowly being introduced to the new map and are a test for the future, much larger map. Forest Road will be getting updates including this as well.
- Dynamic footstep audio for different surfaces had been added.
- Update interaction sounds
- Forgot to mention this last patch but I added a Tent that can easily be built. This will offer players an easy way to create a respawn while they are exploring and trying to find a place to live. Be careful, other players can use your tent spawn as well, as long as it's left in the open. The tent will only last 7 days in-game or 7 hours IRL! 
- Added animation for picking up items
- Added a basic ladder system. This is a test that's only on the Great Lake map, so please try out the ladders around the housing areas and let me know how it is!

[u][b]In progress [/b][/u]
- I'm working on the upcoming large map, although the release might take longer than expected. This is on the top of my list. I am also currently working on a vehicle system to help players get around easier on the larger maps. I really want to add more weapons but just haven't due to the great workload of developing a game solo. I will soon take time to add many more weapons to give players many more ranged/melee weapons to play around with. Trust me, I want new weapons too!

[u][b]Conclusion[/b][/u] 
- Thank you all for the amazing support! Please join the discord or email me to let me know what you want to see added to Desperation!

notes.title: Horde Mode Update! Patch 1.14
notes.content:
[b][u]New to Desperation:[/u][/b]
- I have added a brand new currency called Gold Coins! You can find these Gold Coins by searching the dead bodies of all enemies within the world. The harder enemies will drop more coins than the weaker enemies. You can use these Gold Coins to trade with players or to trade for weapons, food, gear, etc at the Special Vendor located within the Safe Zone! 
- The all-new and improved Horde mode is now out! Recommended player count is 1-3, although you can invite as many friends to join as you'd like! The Gold Coin system exists within Horde mode as well, so kill those zombies and upgrade your arsenal! How long can you survive the onslaught?
- Added a new Sword that can be crafted!

[b][u]Fixes/Improvements:[/u][/b]
- The Safe Zone has been updated to have a better aesthetic.
- There is now a Green Tech Wall that indicates the Safe Zones boundaries.
- All zombies will now drop infected meat on death
- All Deer will now drop 10 raw meat on death to make hunting deer worthwhile.

[b][u]Notes:[/u][/b]
- I will soon be adding a lot more guns/weapons to the Desperation arsenal.
- I've been working on a few new map ideas that will change the way you survive in the world of Desperation. So stay tuned, a new map might pop up before you know it!

As always, I want to give a big thanks to everyone that is supporting me develop Desperation. I couldn't do this without you guys. I plan on increasing the playability and worth of the game, so to keep updated, check on here or visit the official Desperation social media!

You will be able to jump in with friends or alone and fight off hordes of zombies while collecting gold coins to purchase weapons and gear! How long can you last against the zombie onslaught? 
- I will soon be adding more weapons, gear and a brand new enemy to the game! Make sure you follow all social media and join the official Discord to get all major updates of the game!
